starblast-io.title: StarBlast.io - Multiplayer Space Battle Game
starblast-io.slogan: Embark on an interstellar journey and dominate the galaxy!
starblast-io.description: StarBlast.io is an exciting multiplayer online game where you control customizable spaceships and engage in intense battles. Eliminate opponents, collect power-ups, and upgrade your ship to become a formidable force in the galaxy. Join the action-packed universe of StarBlast.io and experience thrilling space combat!
